statement: Runtime database access uses role 'mantra_app' with SELECT and INSERT privileges only. DDL and UPDATE/DELETE operations require 'mantra_owner' role, restricted to migration contexts.
rationale: Principle of least privilege. Runtime application cannot modify schema or existing records. Enforces immutability at database layer. Separation prevents accidental or malicious data modification.

constraints.statement: Runtime role (mantra_app) must have SELECT and INSERT only
Runtime role must not have UPDATE or DELETE privileges
mantra_owner role must be used only in migration context
